geometries.method: Midpoint of the Canary Current crossing observed at 29°N from 22.25–18.50°W in October–November 2009; not a full path.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Excluded from rights-screened preview pending cartographic source review.
length_assessments.scope: A fall 2009 section at 29°N locates a westward extent across the section and separates transport by depth layer. It does not measure the current's along-flow length.

named_current_source_observations.spatial_basis: The paper reports the Canary Current extent along the 29°N section from 22.25°W to 18.5°W. This is a cross-stream band, not an along-current trace.
named_current_source_observations.state_boundary_limit: The reported cross-stream band intersects the approximate NAST E polygon; the state boundary and observed current extent are not surveyed together.
named_current_source_observations.time_detail: The dates bound the entire ORCA cruise; the exact occupation dates of this current band are not separately assigned here.

named_current_source_observations.spatial_basis: The paper reports the Canary Current extent along the 29°N section from 22.25°W to 18.5°W. This is a cross-stream band, not an along-current trace.
named_current_source_observations.state_boundary_limit: The reported cross-stream band intersects the approximate CNRY polygon; the state boundary and observed current extent are not surveyed together.
named_current_source_observations.time_detail: The dates bound the entire ORCA cruise; the exact occupation dates of this current band are not separately assigned here.
